observations: Three photos show a black camera lens with 'AF-S NIKKOR' and '50mm 1:8G' engraved on the front ring.
The lens has a textured focus ring and a manual focus ring with distance markings (m, ft).
The lens appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or major dents.
The background is bubble wrap, suggesting packaging or storage.
No lens cap is visible in any photo.
No signs of fungus, scratches, or major damage are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: American used lens, clean and pure like new.
claims.evidence: The lens appears clean and undamaged in photos, but 'American used' and 'pure like new' cannot be verified remotely. No proof of origin or condition beyond visual inspection.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal lens elements may have fungus, scratches, or haze not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front element under bright light, or a video showing the lens being focused and the image quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective or requiring cleaning/replacement

risks.risk: The lens may be non-functional or have a broken mount or focus mechanism.
risks.proof: A video showing the lens being focused and the image quality, or a photo of the lens attached to a camera body.

risks.risk: The lens may be a counterfeit or non-Nikon product.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens serial number and a close-up of the lens mount and glass.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually on the side or the bottom of the lens.
A video showing the lens being focused and the image quality.
A photo of the lens serial number and a close-up of the lens mount and glass.
A photo of the lens attached to a camera body to confirm functionality.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
